headline: President Bush created a federal task force to coordinate Great Lakes work and encourage regional cooperation on the lakes.
what_it_does: This order set up a Great Lakes Interagency Task Force made up of federal agencies. Based on the title, its job is to help federal agencies work together on Great Lakes issues. It also promotes a regional partnership on the Great Lakes, which likely includes states, tribes, and local groups. No summary was provided, so details such as funding or specific rules are not known.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies with Great Lakes programs
who_it_affects.how: They are organized into a task force meant to coordinate their Great Lakes work.

who_it_affects.group: State, local, and tribal governments in the Great Lakes region
who_it_affects.how: They are encouraged to join a regional effort with the federal government on Great Lakes issues.
